Admin stats (TOTAL/ON TRIAL/PAYING/EXPIRED) all show 0 - investigate /api/admin/stats API response and frontend rendering
critical_code_review_comments: Light theme pages: Plans, Support, Social/Library and Focus/Supps all render with light cream background - not matching dark design tokens. Check if these pages are missing ThemeContext consumption or using hardcoded light styles
context_for_next_testing_agent: All major new features in iteration 3 are working. Key issue: multiple pages (Plans, Support, Focus/Supps tab, Social/Library tab) show light cream background instead of dark #0A0A0A. Admin stats cards showing 0 is a pre-existing issue. Login routing correctly goes to /home now. Calculator accessible at /calculator?type=calorie with all input fields. 5-tab layout confirmed.
